name: M3_PPS115MI_LstAltSupplier
description: Lists supplier agreements or alternate supplier agreements for a specific item number or product number.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for which this alternate supplier record applies.

inputParameters.name: RQQT
inputParameters.description: Required quantity used as the basis for price and agreement evaluation in the requested unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: RQUM
inputParameters.description: Required unit of measure used to convert and display all quantity-related values.

inputParameters.name: DLDT
inputParameters.description: Delivery date used when determining valid agreements and prices for this supplier.

inputParameters.name: SLFR
inputParameters.description: Lowest status value in the range used to filter which records are included.

inputParameters.name: SLTO
inputParameters.description: Highest status value in the range used to filter which records are included.

inputParameters.name: PRCS
inputParameters.description: Service process associated with this alternate supplier record, if applicable.

inputParameters.name: SUFI
inputParameters.description: Service identifier linked to this line for subcontract or repair purchases.

inputParameters.name: ILIN
inputParameters.description: Controls whether inactive item/supplier or agreement lines are included in the result.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for which this alternate supplier record applies.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Item name or description.

outputParameters.name: RQQT
outputParameters.description: Required quantity used as the basis for price and agreement evaluation in the requested unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RQUM
outputParameters.description: Required unit of measure used to convert and display all quantity-related values.

outputParameters.name: DLDT
outputParameters.description: Delivery date used when determining valid agreements and prices for this supplier.

outputParameters.name: PRCS
outputParameters.description: Service process associated with this alternate supplier record, if applicable.

outputParameters.name: SUFI
outputParameters.description: Service identifier linked to this line for subcontract or repair purchases.

outputParameters.name: MASU
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this supplier is defined as the main supplier for the item.

outputParameters.name: QQTY
outputParameters.description: Minimum quantity for which this price or supply condition is valid in the required unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PUUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure used on the purchase order for this item from the supplier.

outputParameters.name: PPUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase price is expressed for this item.

outputParameters.name: ASUN
outputParameters.description: Alternate supplier number offering this item.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number that this price or supply record is based on.

outputParameters.name: PAST
outputParameters.description: Status of the purchase agreement, such as preliminary, valid, fulfilled, or cancelled.

outputParameters.name: ISRS
outputParameters.description: Status of the item/supplier combination, for example registration in progress, approved, or deactivated.

outputParameters.name: ALSU
outputParameters.description: Search key used to identify or group this alternate supplier.

outputParameters.name: AGPT
outputParameters.description: Priority used to rank this agreement against other agreements for the same supplier.

outputParameters.name: LEA1
outputParameters.description: Supply lead time in days for delivering this item from the supplier.

outputParameters.name: FVDT
outputParameters.description: Date from which this agreement or price record is valid.

outputParameters.name: UVDT
outputParameters.description: Date until which this agreement or price record is valid.

outputParameters.name: NEPR
outputParameters.description: Net price for the item from this supplier, after discounts, in the stated currency.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Currency code in which the net price is expressed.

outputParameters.name: NEPL
outputParameters.description: Net price converted to the division’s local currency.

outputParameters.name: LOCD
outputParameters.description: Local currency code used by the division.

outputParameters.name: FRQT
outputParameters.description: From-quantity level at which this price or agreement condition starts to apply.

outputParameters.name: PUQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated purchased quantity for this agreement or item/supplier combination in the base unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: AGQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity committed in the agreement for this item and supplier.

outputParameters.name: VOLI
outputParameters.description: Purchase commitment setting indicating whether the agreed quantity is informational, a minimum, or a maximum obligation.
